data.caption: as the heat climbs, so does the tower
data.title: PARIS, ONE YEAR

script: Here is a strange fact about the Eiffel Tower. Every summer, it grows taller. By about fifteen centimetres. The reason is simple. Iron expands when it gets hot. In winter, the metal contracts, and the tower shrinks back down. Look at the chart. As the temperature climbs, so does the tower. The same steel, the same tower, just a little taller in July than in January. So the most famous landmark in Paris is never quite the same height twice.
topic: The Eiffel Tower grows in summer
